admin_settings.intro: Configure runtime settings without editing .env or restarting containers. Sensitive values are encrypted at rest.

sections.general: Small toggles and miscellaneous app settings — start with the home page on/off.
sections.sso: Configure one or more OIDC identity providers (Microsoft Entra, Google, Authentik, Keycloak, …). Users connect their account to a provider for one-click sign-in.
sections.api_tokens: Decide who can mint programmatic API tokens — everyone, employees only, admins only, or disabled. Add specific users or groups to an allowlist on top.
sections.public_links: Decide who can create shareable public links to a share — everyone, employees only, admins only, or disabled. Add specific users or groups to an allowlist on top.
sections.email: Configure outbound SMTP — host, port, credentials, TLS mode, From address. Send a test email and see the actual error if something's wrong.
sections.twofa: Decide who must enable 2FA — pick any combination of roles (admin / employee / client) and groups. Affected users without TOTP get bounced into the setup flow on every page load until they enrol.
sections.quarantine: When ClamAV flags an upload, optionally fan out a notification (email + in-app bell) to every admin in addition to the uploader.

admin_general.title: General
admin_general.intro: Small toggles and miscellaneous app settings. New minor settings land here as they're introduced.

admin_twofa_policy.title: Two-factor enforcement
admin_twofa_policy.intro: Choose the roles and groups whose members must enable a TOTP authenticator. Affected users without 2FA are blocked from every page other than the setup wizard until they enrol.
admin_twofa_policy.kv_inheritance_note: No saved policy yet — currently inheriting from the REQUIRE_2FA environment variable. Saving here takes over.
admin_twofa_policy.roles_help: Tick a role to require 2FA for every user with it.
admin_twofa_policy.groups_help: Members of any ticked group must enrol — additive on top of the role list.
admin_twofa_policy.effect_redirect: Affected users are redirected to /account/2fa/forced on every navigation until they finish setup.
admin_twofa_policy.effect_recovery: Recovery codes still bypass login one-time so an enrolled user who loses their authenticator isn't locked out.
admin_twofa_policy.effect_lockout: If you save a policy that applies to you and you don't yet have 2FA, you'll be redirected straight into the QR enrolment wizard — no intermediate lockout. Recovery codes still bypass login one-time if you ever lose your authenticator.

admin_site_url.title: Site URL
admin_site_url.intro: The URL the SPA is served from. Used in every email link, public-link URL, in-app notification deep link, and post-OIDC browser redirect.
admin_site_url.url_help: Include the scheme (https:// recommended). No trailing slash. Saving here takes effect immediately for new emails and notifications.
admin_site_url.env_fallback: Falls back to the APP_URL env var: {url}
admin_site_url.security_note: Two surfaces stay on the env value and are NOT changed by this field: WebAuthn passkey RP origin (changing it silently invalidates every registered passkey) and OIDC redirect URI (IdPs reject mismatches against their pre-registered URI).

admin_home_page.title: Home page
admin_home_page.intro: The home page is the welcome screen users see at /. Disable it if you'd rather drop everyone straight into a working surface (Sent / Received / New share).
admin_home_page.toggle_help: When enabled, / shows a welcome card with the user's name, role, and quick links. When disabled, / redirects forward and the page is hidden.
admin_home_page.effect_picker: "Home" disappears from the per-user landing-page picker.
admin_home_page.effect_brand: The file:Heron wordmark in the top header becomes plain text (no link).
admin_home_page.effect_redirect: Anyone hitting / is redirected to their saved landing page or to /share/new.

admin_share_defaults.title: Share defaults
admin_share_defaults.intro: Controls the initial state of the "Notify recipient(s)" checkbox on the new-share form. Senders can still flip it per share.
admin_share_defaults.toggle_label: Notify recipients by default when a new share is created
admin_share_defaults.toggle_help: When on, the checkbox is pre-checked and `share_created` emails fan out to direct recipients and to every active member of any recipient group. When off, the sender opts in per share.

admin_motd.title: Login banner (MOTD)
admin_motd.intro: Optional notice shown on the public login page. Use for planned-maintenance announcements, onboarding info, or anything you want every visitor to see before signing in. Plain text, max 500 characters.
admin_motd.toggle_label: Show the banner on the login page
admin_motd.toggle_help: When off, the banner is hidden regardless of the text below.
admin_motd.text_placeholder: Scheduled maintenance Saturday 14:00 UTC — expect a 5-minute outage.

admin_email.title: Email / SMTP
admin_email.intro: Outgoing notifications, invites, password resets and shares all flow through this SMTP server. Saving here takes effect immediately — no restart. The password is encrypted at rest.
admin_email.env_only: values come from .env (no DB overrides yet)
admin_email.host_help: Hostname or IP of the SMTP server.

tls.starttls_help: Connect plaintext, upgrade to TLS via STARTTLS. Most common; default for port 587.
tls.implicit_help: TLS from the first byte. Used by some legacy SMTPS deployments on port 465.
tls.none_help: No transport encryption. Only sane on localhost / a private MTA on a trusted network.

admin_email.password_help: Stored encrypted at rest. Leave blank to keep the current password unchanged.
admin_email.test_help: Sends one email synchronously using the values currently filled in above (no need to save first). The actual SMTP error is shown inline if it fails.

admin_public_link_policy.title: Public link policy
admin_public_link_policy.intro: Public links let recipients without a fileHeron account download a share via a token URL. Pick who's allowed to create them. Admins can always create links regardless of mode.

mode.everyone_help: Any signed-in user can create public links.
mode.admins_only_help: Only admins can create public links.
mode.disabled_help: Only admins can create public links; everyone else is blocked.

admin_public_link_policy.allowlist_help: Users and groups added here can always create public links, regardless of the base policy.

admin_api_tokens.create_heading: Generate a token on behalf of a user
admin_api_tokens.create_help: The plaintext appears once on this page. Copy it and forward to the user via a secure channel (password manager / encrypted DM).
admin_api_tokens.no_user_selected: Select a user from the suggestions first.
admin_api_tokens.plaintext_warning: Copy this now — it will not be shown again. Forward to the user via your password / secrets manager.
admin_api_tokens.search_placeholder: Search by owner name or email…
admin_api_tokens.empty: No API tokens match the current filters.
admin_api_tokens.revoke_confirm: Permanently revoke this token? This cannot be undone — the user will need a brand-new token to keep automating.

admin_token_policy.title: API token policy
admin_token_policy.intro: API tokens grant programmatic access — pick who's allowed to create them. Admins can always create tokens regardless of the mode (operator escape hatch).

mode.everyone_help: Any signed-in user can create tokens.
mode.disabled_help: Only admins can create tokens; everyone else is blocked.

admin_token_policy.allowlist_help: Users and groups added here can always mint tokens, regardless of the base policy.

admin_sso_list.title: SSO
admin_sso_list.intro: Run multiple OIDC identity providers concurrently. Users can connect their fileHeron account to one of them; new users sign in once with their password and click Connect.
admin_sso_list.empty_body: Add an OIDC provider to let users sign in with their identity provider.

admin_sso_edit.name: Display name
admin_sso_edit.name_help: Shown to users on the login page button.
admin_sso_edit.issuer_url_help: We append /.well-known/openid-configuration to discover the endpoints.
admin_sso_edit.client_secret_help: Stored Fernet-encrypted in the database. Leave blank to keep the current secret unchanged. Empty string clears it.
admin_sso_edit.secret_set_placeholder: (secret already set — leave blank to keep)
admin_sso_edit.secret_required_on_create: Client secret is required when creating a new provider.
admin_sso_edit.groups_claim_help: Dot-walkable path. "groups" for most IdPs; "realm_access.roles" for Keycloak.
admin_sso_edit.redirect_uri_help: Only set this if your IdP requires a specific redirect URI different from the default.
admin_sso_edit.delete_confirm: Delete this SSO provider? Users currently linked to it will need to be unlinked first.

account_oidc.section_help: Connect your fileHeron account to an identity provider. Once connected you can sign in with one click — no password.
account_oidc.no_providers: No SSO providers are configured yet.
account_oidc.other_linked: You're linked to another provider — disconnect first to switch.
account_oidc.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect from this SSO provider? You'll need to sign in with your password until you reconnect.

webauthn.title: Passkeys & security keys
webauthn.intro: Register a passkey (Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a USB security key) as a second factor. You can register multiple — your laptop's built-in authenticator and a USB key as a backup, for example.
webauthn.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support passkeys. Try a recent Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge.
webauthn.remove_confirm: Remove this passkey? You won't be able to use it to sign in anymore.

notif_prefs.title: Notifications
notif_prefs.intro: Choose how you'd like to be notified for each event. "Both" means email and the bell.

admin_users.invite_email_help: We'll send a 24h single-use invite link.
admin_users.invite_display_name_help: How they'll be addressed in the invite email.
admin_users.invite_groups_help: Memberships are applied when the invitee accepts the invite.

invites.heading: Pending invites
invites.help: Users who were invited but haven't yet activated their account.

toast.activated: Account activated. They can sign in immediately.

activate.title: Activate account directly
activate.body: Create a fully active account for {email} with role {role}, bypassing the invitee's password-set step. They can sign in via SSO immediately. The invite link will no longer work.
activate.display_name_help: Defaults to the email's local part. Edit if you'd prefer something else; the user can change it later.

revoke.title: Revoke invite
revoke.body: The invite link for {email} will stop working. The recipient cannot complete registration after this. Continue?

admin_user_detail.quota_help: Total upload bytes allowed for this user. Leave blank or 0 for unlimited.
admin_user_detail.force_reset_confirm: Generate a one-time reset token? The current password keeps working until the user clicks the link.
admin_user_detail.reset_warning: Share this token via a secure out-of-band channel. The link expires in 1 hour.
admin_user_detail.erase_help: Right-to-erasure permanently anonymizes this user and hard-deletes every file they uploaded. The action cannot be undone.
admin_user_detail.erase_step1: This will hard-delete every file this user uploaded. The user row is anonymized to [erased]. The action is irreversible.
admin_user_detail.erase_step2: Final confirmation. Click once more to erase.

account.title: Account
account.language_help: Used for emails sent to you and the UI language.
account.display_name_help: Shown on shares and emails. 1–120 characters.

landing.label: Default landing page
landing.help: Where you land after logging in. Pick "System default" to follow whatever the admin has chosen for everyone.

account.change_password_help: After changing, you'll need to sign in again on every device.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.intro: Use an authenticator app — 1Password, Authy, Bitwarden, Google Authenticator — to scan the QR below.
twofa.forced_banner: Your administrator requires two-factor authentication for your account. Scan the code below to finish setup and continue.
twofa.verify_help: Enter the six-digit code your app shows now.
twofa.saved_codes_intro: Each code works once. Use them if you lose access to your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe — we won't show them again.
twofa.active_intro: You'll need a code from your authenticator app on every sign-in.
twofa.disable_intro: Removing two-factor weakens your account. You'll need your password and a current code (or one recovery code) to confirm.

dropzone.hint: Up to 30 GB per file. Resume picks up where the connection drops.

recipient.label: Recipients

actions.delete_confirm: Delete this file? This cannot be undone.

api_tokens.title: API tokens
api_tokens.intro: Tokens authorize programmatic uploads via the API or TUS clients. Create one per script or device.
api_tokens.plaintext_warning: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again. Store it where the calling script can read it.
api_tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? Any script using it will stop working immediately.
api_tokens.disabled_by_admin: Your administrator has restricted API token creation. Ask an admin if you need a token for automation.

share_create.title: New share

intro.outbound: Send files to a client or colleague. They'll get an email with a link.
intro.inbound: Send files to your contact. They'll get an email letting them know.

share_create.message_placeholder: Optional — a note for the recipient.
share_create.recipients_or_public_link_hint: …or skip recipients and attach a public link below.
share_create.notify_recipients_help: Send a `share_created` email + in-app notification to every direct recipient and to every active member of any recipient group. Uncheck to keep this share quiet.
share_create.toast_partial: {n} file(s) failed to upload. Retry below.

public_link.toggle_label: Also create a public download link
public_link.toggle_help: Anyone with the link can download — no fileHeron account needed. Optionally protect with a password and a download counter.
public_link.password_help: Anyone with the link will need this password to unlock the share.
public_link.download_limit_help: Maximum number of successful downloads. Leave blank for unlimited.
public_link.result_warning: Copy this URL now — it won't be shown again. Send it to the recipient via your usual channel.

share_detail.revoke_confirm: Revoke this share? Files become inaccessible to the recipient.
share_detail.expire_now_confirm: Expire this share now and delete all uploaded files? This cannot be undone.

public_link.title: Public link
public_link.intro: Generate a URL anyone can use to download this share's files. Optionally protect with a password and limit how many times it can be used.
public_link.url_legacy_hint: URL not stored — this link was created before the viewable-URL feature shipped. Revoke and re-create to get a viewable URL.
public_link.url_lost: The full URL was shown only when the link was created — keep it somewhere safe. Revoke and re-create if you've lost it.
public_link.revoke_confirm: Revoke this public link? Anyone with the URL will lose access immediately.
public_link.url_warning: Copy the URL now. It will not be shown again.
public_link.password_help: Recipients will need to enter this before downloading.
public_link.limit_help: After this many downloads, the link auto-revokes.
public_link.notify_help: Get notified when someone downloads via this link.

public_share.password_help: The sender shared a password to access these files.

errors.PUBLIC_LINK_EXHAUSTED: This link has reached its download limit.
errors.PUBLIC_LINK_LOCKED: This link is temporarily locked due to repeated failed unlocks. Try again later.
errors.SHARE_NOT_ACTIVE: This share is no longer active.

admin_groups.is_inbox_help: Clients can target this group for inbound shares.

admin_group_detail.remove_confirm: Remove this member? They lose access to past group-targeted shares.
admin_group_detail.danger_help: Deleting a group is only allowed if no active share targets it.
admin_group_detail.delete_confirm: Delete this group? This cannot be undone.

bulk.select_all_aria: Select all active shares on this page

toast.all_failed: Could not expire any of the selected shares.

admin_file_history.intro: Every file ever uploaded — including expired and deleted — joined with parent share metadata, uploader, and download stats.
admin_file_history.search_placeholder: Search filename, uploader name or email…
admin_file_history.empty: No files match the current filters.

admin_quarantine.intro: Files ClamAV flagged as infected. The bytes are kept on disk under ./data/quarantine/ so you can download them for forensic review, release them back to the owner if you're confident the verdict was a false positive, or purge them once you're done.
admin_quarantine.empty: Nothing in quarantine. Either nothing has been flagged or everything was already released or purged.
admin_quarantine.search_placeholder: Search filename, uploader name or email…

confirm.release_help: Marks the file clean and (when ClamAV was the only revoke reason) reactivates the share. The bytes move from quarantine back to active storage. The uploader's quota is re-reserved.
confirm.purge_help: Deletes the quarantined bytes from disk. The file row stays at state=infected as the historical marker. Irreversible.
confirm.reason_placeholder: Why are you taking this action? Goes into the audit log.

toast.released: File released back to the owner.

admin_settings_quarantine.title: Quarantine alerts
admin_settings_quarantine.intro: When ClamAV detects an infected upload, the uploader is always notified. This toggle additionally fans out a notification (email + in-app bell) to every admin.
admin_settings_quarantine.toggle_label: Notify all admins when a virus is detected
admin_settings_quarantine.toggle_help: Each admin gets an email + an in-app bell ring per detection. An admin can mute themselves from /account → Notifications by switching the "file_quarantined" channel to "off" (default is "both" — email + in-app).
